title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - workspace foundations
description: Provider-neutral wire shapes for the workspace descriptor and the `workspace.list` / `workspace.create` / `workspace.inspect` operation payloads (ADR-038, ADR-039). `workspace.list` and `workspace.create` are installation-scoped: their inputs carry no workspace identifier. `workspace.inspect` is workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace and never carries a second, independent workspace identifier in its own input. This document declares no root type; it is a definition container only.

WorkspaceStatus.title: WorkspaceStatus
WorkspaceStatus.description: Open, dot-namespaced code naming a workspace's lifecycle status, such as `active` or `provisioning` or `archived`. Open by design so a compatible minor release can add statuses without breaking existing decoders.

WorkspaceCompatibility.title: WorkspaceCompatibility
WorkspaceCompatibility.description: The concrete workspace-format version a workspace is stored at, and the inclusive version window this server build can read and write. Reuses the same `VersionWindow` and `OpenCode` primitives `VersionCapabilityEnvelope` negotiates with, rather than inventing a second version model.

workspace_format_version.description: Concrete workspace-format version this workspace is currently stored at.

supported_workspace_versions.description: Inclusive workspace-format version window this server build can read and write.

status.description: Compatibility status of `workspace_format_version` against `supported_workspace_versions`. Known values are listed in `compatibility.schema.json`'s `x-omnivia-compatibility-statuses`; unknown values must be preserved.

WorkspaceDescriptor.title: WorkspaceDescriptor
WorkspaceDescriptor.description: A workspace's identity, display name, lifecycle status, format compatibility, and lifecycle timestamps.

workspace_id.description: Stable, server-assigned identifier of this workspace.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this workspace.

compatibility.description: Concrete workspace-format version and the compatibility window it falls within.

updated_at.description: When this workspace's descriptor was last updated, when known.

WorkspaceListInput.title: WorkspaceListInput
WorkspaceListInput.description: Input for `workspace.list`. Installation-scoped: carries no workspace identifier, since it lists every workspace the caller's installation-level authority can see.

limit.description: Bounded maximum number of workspaces to return in this page.

page.description: Continuation position from a prior page, when paging.

workspaces.description: Workspaces visible to the caller's installation-level authority, in this page.

page.description: Continuation position for the next page, absent on the last page.

WorkspaceCreateInput.title: WorkspaceCreateInput
WorkspaceCreateInput.description: Input for `workspace.create`. Installation-scoped: carries only installation-level creation data, and never a caller-supplied workspace identifier.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the new workspace.

WorkspaceCreateResult.title: WorkspaceCreateResult
WorkspaceCreateResult.description: Result of `workspace.create`: the concrete created workspace, including its server-assigned identifier and format compatibility. Never a sentinel or placeholder workspace identifier.

workspace.description: The concrete workspace that was created.

WorkspaceInspectInput.title: WorkspaceInspectInput
WorkspaceInspectInput.description: Input for `workspace.inspect`. Workspace-scoped: the workspace to inspect is the request envelope's selected workspace; this payload never carries a second, independent workspace identifier.

WorkspaceInspectResult.title: WorkspaceInspectResult
WorkspaceInspectResult.description: Result of `workspace.inspect`: the envelope-selected workspace's concrete descriptor.
